entities.name: Kardur
entities.description: Kardur, the Doomscourge, a fearsome demon berserker jarl of Immersturm on Kaldheim imprisoned beneath the earth by rival demon leaders.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: Realm of the demons on Kaldheim, where they are bound by runes placed by the gods.

entities.name: Fields of Elskul
entities.description: Desolate fields where demon armies wage warfare.

entities.name: Demon jarls
entities.description: Demon warlords of Immersturm who raid and war endlessly.

events.summary: Rival demon leaders combine their strength to imprison Kardur hundreds of miles below the surface.
events.quote: the rival demon leaders combined their strength to imprison Kardur deep beneath the earth

events.summary: Kardur gradually claws his way back toward the surface.
events.quote: Kardur is gradually clawing his way back toward the surface

relations.quote: the rival demon leaders combined their strength to imprison Kardur deep beneath the earth
Among these warlords, Kardur stood out as one of the most terrifying and relentless jarls
